answer: Reputation-weighted deposit aging: each identity’s deposit must mature through repeated small transactions before it counts toward influence, so fresh accounts start near zero weight. Like shale settling into layers, trust accrues only with time and volume, and a dune of new accounts collapses under the deposit cost of sustained activity. Attackers must fund every identity through that full maturation period, paying transaction fees and locked capital per account. Honest users grow their standing like a garden, slowly but without subsidizing fakes.
